text:
Sam: quick preflight — I'm planning to change the streaming deltas from the chat/completions endpoint to include an explicit tool_call sequence id and chunked output events. dropping a sketch below. please flag compatibility or runtime concerns.

Alex: are we sure older clients will tolerate unknown event types? they'll usually ignore unknown fields but some stream parsers treat new "event" values as errors.

Priya: +1 re parsers. if we stick to a small delta shape that reuses existing fields it's safer. can we encode as: {type: "delta", meta:{tool_call:{id, name}}, content: {chunk}} ?

Sam: thinking: keep ordering guarantees: start -> chunk* -> end. new event types: tool_call.start, tool_output.chunk, tool_call.end. consumers that ignore unknown event types should still work if they skip tool events. runtime will also add correlation metadata. proposed wire (ndjson):

```
{"event":"tool_call.start","id":"$call_id","name":"search","params":{"q":"foo"}}
{"event":"tool_output.chunk","id":"$call_id","seq":1,"chunk":"result part 1"}
{"event":"tool_output.chunk","id":"$call_id","seq":2,"chunk":"result part 2","final":true}
{"event":"tool_call.end","id":"$call_id","return_value":{"hits":12}}
```

Evan: runtime note: we currently batch streaming outputs across requests for GPU efficiency. we need a stable per-call correlation id before batching merges payloads. otherwise seq numbers will mix. can we ensure call_id is stable and opaque? also non-blocking: what about partial tool outputs that are JSON fragments vs plain text?

Sam: good call. call_id will be a UUID and always present on tool events. chunk content can be either "text" or "json_fragment" with an explicit encoding field. we'll add a "encoding" attribute: "text" | "json" | "binary-base64".

Alex: for backcompat, how about a header opt-in: `X-Redwood-Stream-Schema: v2`? older clients won't receive tool events unless they opt-in. avoids surprising partial-parsers.

Priya: I'd prefer feature-gating by client header + server-side flag. helps rollout. I'll own docs + migration notes. also add a quick test harness example for the node SDK.

deploy-bot: feature flag `streaming-toolcall-seq` enabled in staging :rocket:

Sam: ok i'll wire the header check + emit the schema version in the initial connect event. i'll open a draft PR with the runtime changes and a small test plan.

Evan: ping me on the PR for the batching bit. can we add a lightweight integration test that runs streamed toolcall through our batching path?

Priya: will add. thanks all :thumbsup:
